Tool Features
Our simulation models go beyond nominal data from data sheets and offer corner simulation capabilities based on physical correlations in the manufacturing environment. This allows users to understand device performance at the boundaries of process conditions in the fab, simulating from nominal to worst-case conditions.
Fast Simulation Results
Users can easily explore figures of merits and their tradeoffs per device, circuit topology, control strategy variations, and load profiling.
High-Density & Broad-Loss Tables
Dense tables ensure accurate interpolation instead of inaccurate extrapolation in the system simulations, making them valid for both hard and soft switching.
Flexible Use
The simulator is flexible to accommodate adjustments to various attributes such as system specifications, gate drive impedance, cooling designs, and product corner case performance.
